# BD Growth Suite

> Brilliant Directories developers. A dedicated developer team for setup, customization, AI automation, and growth.

Clean markdown copies of each page live at the same URL with `.md` appended (e.g. `/services/` -> `/services.md`). Served by Laravel middleware (ProvideMarkdownResponse). Google ignores this file for ranking; it exists to help ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity read the site.
